Name: Craftable Mushroom Boxes by foggywizard (Unofficial 1.6 Update)
Author: PeeH3ll
Description:
Makes the vanilla mushroom boxes craftable and moveable! Earn 40k gold and 3 hearts of friendship with Demetrius and he'll send you a letter with the recipe!
Change the recipe if you don't like it by changing the items used and the amount of them!

Note: The code that makes mushroom boxes moveable will not work on preexisting mushroom boxes. This is not something I can fix because it's due to an item's code getting baked into the item upon creation. Try something that resets your farm cave to be able to move already placed boxes.

The Recipe has changed! I change the petrified slime with the Moss 

And Normally if you use any alternative Farmcave you will get the letter as well, once you fullfill the requirement
